note: hydrate -> dehydrate -> hydrate on one thread; asserts the tree is byte-identical to the start and the manifest entry returns. THE CONTROL IS THE MIDDLE STATE, and it is what the round trip cannot supply: measured, a dehydrate that removes nothing round-trips PERFECTLY, so the entry leaving the manifest and the files leaving the disk are both asserted between the two hydrations. Five source mutations, applied and reverted one at a time, each redden a named assertion; the table is in the test file. Known limitation: nothing here covers a thread with attachments.
